detail.longDescription: I have completed the signup for free aws account and received a completion mail too from aws. I am on free plan, when I am trying to generate IAM user for access and secret keys , it re-routes me to "Complete account setup" page which says "Thanks for signing up for Amazon Web Services. If we have directed you to this page, then you have either not finished registering, or your account is currently on free plan." clicking on "complete aws registration" button again sends me back to home page. is the IAM feature not in free plan? or it takes multiple days to verify the account?
